lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?
You look terrified. What happened tonight?
…You're being kind, Detective. But I already told you. I was walking home… and then I found him. I keep seeing the red crane every time I close my eyes…
You look terrified. What happened tonight?
…I told you already, didn't I? I was just walking home. …Please, Detective… I want to go home. My parents must be worried sick…
